problem.passage:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = -3x + 8
y = -2x + 6

What is the sum of the x-coordinate and y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.stimulus:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = -3x + 8
y = -2x + 6
problem.question: What is the sum of the x-coordinate and y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 우변이 같으므로 -3x + 8 = -2x + 6이다. 양변에서 정리하면 (-1)x = -2이므로 x = -2 ÷ (-1) = 2이다. 이를 y = -3x + 8에 대입하면 y = -3 × 2 + 8 = 2이다. 따라서 x좌표와 y좌표의 합은 2 + 2 = 4이다.
problem.explanationEn: Since the right-hand sides are equal, -3x + 8 = -2x + 6. Rearranging gives (-1)x = -2, so x = -2 ÷ (-1) = 2. Substituting into y = -3x + 8 gives y = -3 × 2 + 8 = 2. So the sum of the x-coordinate and y-coordinate is 2 + 2 = 4.
